items.example: She's a stunt double — she's afraid of nothing.
When someone is in trouble, do people stop and help or just walk on by?
Stunt performers take risks for a living.
Broken bones are all part of the job.
She woke up with a few aches and pains.
In the end she's a family person.
Most stunt performers talk about the excitement, the challenge and the big money.
